'''Emotes''' were added in [[Update Log|'''Update 9''']]. They are dances or movements you can do in game. The majority can be bought from '''All Force''' with Trophies inside the Leaderboard Area.

Equip emotes through the '''Profile''' menu in the right side of your screen.

Press '''X''' or '''Period''' on the keyboard to open up the '''emote menu'''.
